publications.headline: Digital twins for adaptive supply chains
publications.title: Digital Twin-Enabled Predictive Intelligence Framework for Supply Chain 5.0: Hybrid Deep Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Real-Time Adaptive and Self-Optimizing Decision Management
publications.journal: The Asian Bulletin of Big Data Management
publications.summary: A simulation-based study combining a virtual supply-chain model with learning algorithms to evaluate inventory, sourcing, and distribution decisions under uncertainty.
publications.approach: The framework tests decision policies in a simulated multi-stage supply chain, with human oversight included in its design.

publications.headline: AI for cost-aware payment fraud detection
publications.title: An Advanced AI-Empowered FinTech Framework for Credit Card Fraud Detection in Online Transactions via Sparrow Search Algorithm–Based Adaptive Optimization
publications.summary: Exploring how adaptive model tuning can identify rare fraudulent transactions while accounting for the unequal costs of missed fraud and false alarms.
publications.approach: The proposed method uses Sparrow Search optimization to tune model settings and classification thresholds, with evaluation suited to imbalanced transaction data.

publications.headline: Geospatial AI for smarter logistics
publications.title: Geospatial AI Logistics Networks: Using Satellite Analytics and Machine Learning to Optimize Global Transportation Routes
publications.summary: Investigating how satellite information and machine learning can support transportation routing, delivery reliability, and more efficient fuel use.
publications.approach: The study combines operational records with geographic data and examines routing models, including their data-quality and interpretability challenges.
